question: When was the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award won by Karnam Malleswari?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1994-95**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Karnam Malleswari** was awarded the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award in **1994-95**.
 
• She is an Indian weightlifter and the **first Indian woman to win an Olympic medal** (bronze in the 2000 Sydney Olympics).
 
• The Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna is India's **highest sporting honor**, awarded annually for outstanding performance in sports.
 
• Malleswari was honored for her exceptional achievements in weightlifting, including world championship victories.
 
• She became a role model for aspiring athletes and significantly contributed to the popularity of weightlifting in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award:**

 
 
• Established in 1991-92, it is named after the legendary Indian hockey player Major Dhyan Chand.
 
• The award includes a medal, a certificate, and a cash prize of Rs. 25 lakhs.
 
• It recognizes athletes for their extraordinary performance at international sports events.
 
 
 
• **Karnam Malleswari's Achievements:**
 
 
• She won the World Weightlifting Championships twice and multiple medals in Asian Games and Commonwealth Games.
 
• Her bronze medal at the 2000 Sydney Olympics was India's first Olympic medal in weightlifting.
 
• She was awarded the Padma Shri in 1999 for her contributions to Indian sports.
 
 
 
• **Indian Weightlifting:**
 
 
• Weightlifting is governed by the Indian Weightlifting Federation (IWF).
 
• India has produced several successful weightlifters, including Mirabai Chanu and Satish Sivalingam.
 
• Indian athletes have consistently performed well in regional and international competitions.
 
 
 
• **Impact of the Award:**
 
 
• The Khel Ratna Award motivates athletes to strive for excellence.
 
• It helps in promoting sports culture and raising awareness about lesser-known sports like weightlifting.
 
• Awardees often serve as inspirations for the younger generation of athletes.
